<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-ui-reference.mjs. -->

Supply options with value and label. Duplicate values keep the first option and empty values are skipped. Pass an empty string as value to clear the current selection. Handle valueChange to write the chosen string to State.

## Usage

```ts
import { combobox } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/combobox';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/combobox`. It [registers](../../registration/) 1 component for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-combobox"></a>

### `shadcn.Combobox`

This is a JSON composition.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Default `false` |
| `emptyText` | `string` | Default `"No options found."` |
| `options` | `Array<{ value: string, label: string, disabled?: boolean }>` | Default `[]` · `[]` no extra fields |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Default `"Select an option"` |
| `searchPlaceholder` | `string` | Default `"Search options…"` |
| `value` | `string` | Default `""` |

No slots.

| Event | `value` in payload | Codec and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `valueChange` | `string` | — |

#### Example View

```json
{
  "render": {
    "id": "example",
    "componentRef": "shadcn.Combobox",
    "inputs": {
      "value": "seoul",
      "options": [
        {
          "value": "seoul",
          "label": "Seoul"
        },
        {
          "value": "busan",
          "label": "Busan"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
